subject: Retention & backup purge — temporary log hold and deletion workflow
messages:
From: Eleanor Reyes <eleanor.reyes@archwell.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@archwell.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention & backup purge — request for temporary log hold and deletion schedule

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this — Archwell’s security & legal teams have a short request ahead of an upcoming audit. We need a temporary extension on log retention for a scoped set of EU production hosts while our compliance team completes a forensic review. Specifically: 

- Scope: EU-prod only (service: text-inference cluster eu-west-1, customer namespace: archwell-prod)
- Request: extend ephemeral log retention from the default 7 days to 45 days for the window 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-31
- Backups: we need confirmation of the backup purge schedule and evidence that the standard purge job will skip the affected retention window (and a way to prove deletion after the hold)

Additionally, Archwell's procurement is asking for (1) a current DPA subprocessor list that covers storage and backups and (2) a short description of the deletion workflow (who triggers purges, what evidence/logs are kept, and how we can validate deletions).

We can sign a short amendment if required. Is this something you can coordinate internally today? We’d appreciate: timeline, a contact who can provide the backup manifest, and any required paperwork (DocuSign link) to formalize the temporary hold.

Thanks,
Eleanor
Eleanor Reyes
Head of IT Risk — Archwell Health
E: eleanor.reyes@archwell.com
A: +44 20 8123 4567

Attachments: none in this message

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Reyes <eleanor.reyes@archwell.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention & backup purge — request for temporary log hold and deletion schedule

Hi Eleanor — thanks for the clear ask. I’ll take point and coordinate across infra + legal. High level plan and immediate asks below: 

1) Scope confirmation (you already indicated EU-prod / archwell-prod) — please confirm whether this includes staging or just production.
2) Temporary retention plan we propose: 
   - Implement a 45-day ephemeral log hold via a retention flag on the archwell-prod namespace.
   - The hold will prevent automated purge jobs for the affected keys between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-31.
   - Post-hold, we will run a validated purge job and provide deletion evidence (purge-job id + checksum / manifest).
3) Deliverables we will provide today: 
   - Subprocessor attestation PDF (storage & backup providers)
   - Backup manifest CSV for snapshots touching archwell-prod (attached)
   - Purge job log excerpt after we run the post-hold deletion (will deliver once complete)
4) Paperwork: Marissa (legal) will prepare a 1-page DPA amendment/temporary-hold addendum and we’ll send via DocuSign.

Next steps: please confirm scope (prod only) and reply if you need a more constrained subset (specific host IDs or date ranges). Once you confirm, Karthik will flip the retention flag and provide the manifest/ops notes. Marissa will send the DocuSign link.

I’ll follow up with the attachments and timeline within the hour.

—Grace O’Connor
Sr. Customer Success (Operations) — Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Eleanor Reyes <eleanor.reyes@archwell.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention & backup purge — request for temporary log hold and deletion schedule

Grace / Eleanor — technical notes and operational plan from infra: 

- How the hold works: we set a retention_override tag on objects with prefix: archwell-prod/ephemeral-logs/YYYYMMDD/* to prevent the nightly purge orchestrator from queueing deletion tasks for those keys. The override is scoped to keys created between 2026-09-15 and 2026-10-31.
- Engineered timeline: 
   * T=0 (on confirmation): retention_override applied — immediate (within 15m)
   * T+window end (2026-10-31 23:59 UTC): we run a staged purge job (purge-run id: PURGE-4387) that will process archived keys with the override removed.
   * T+1h after purge: we will generate a proof bundle (manifest + SHA256 checksums for deleted blobs + purge-job-log) and upload to a secure audit bucket.
- Validation: we keep a purge-job-log entry and a signed manifest. The manifest file is named backup_manifest_2026-09.csv and we’ll attach a purge-job-log-4387.txt excerpt.
- Rollback / recovery: we snapshot keys before purge and keep them in a 14-day escrow (protected bucket) strictly for 14 days post-purge to allow validated recovery if needed. After the 14-day escrow we will permanently remove snapshots.

Operational caveats: ephemeral logs live on object storage with lifecycle rules; database-level WALs are not part of the requested hold unless specifically named. If Archwell needs DB-level WAL retention, we need separate approval and will require a ticket to infra-db team.

I’ll apply the override after Grace confirms scope.

—Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Reyes <eleanor.reyes@archwell.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention & backup purge — request for temporary log hold and deletion schedule

Hi Eleanor — legal here. A couple quick items to keep this tidy for both sides: 

- DPA amendment: we’ll prepare a one-page addendum (temporary hold) that references the affected namespace and exact date window (2026-09-15 through 2026-10-31). This will include the subprocessor attestation and the purge validation steps.
- Signatures: we’ll send via DocuSign link; please have an authorized signatory for Archwell (procurement usually handles) sign the amendment.
- Evidence: Redwood will deliver the backup_manifest_2026-09.csv and subprocessor_attestation_2026-09.pdf today. After the post-hold purge, we will provide purge-job-log-4387.txt and the signed SHA256 manifest.
- Retention carveouts & region: one key point — since this is EU production data, we’ll note cross-border transfer constraints in the addendum. If Archwell requires zero-transfer outside EU for the escrow snapshots, please flag that now.

DocuSign draft is queued; link: https://docusign.example/archwell-retention-amendment/ABC123 (placeholder). I’ll loop in Kimberly for procurement/discounts if procurement asks for credits for operational overhead — Kimberly, can you advise whether we should offer short-term credits for the 45-day hold?

—Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
Attachments: subprocessor_attestation_2026-09.pdf, backup_manifest_2026-09.csv

From: Eleanor Reyes <eleanor.reyes@archwell.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Procurements Team <procurements@archwell.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention & backup purge — request for temporary log hold and deletion schedule

Thanks, all — confirmed: EU-prod only (no staging), Archwell authorized signatory will sign the single-page amendment. We do require the escrow snapshots to remain within the EU region for the 14-day escrow period — please reflect that in the addendum.

Procurements will complete DocuSign today. Looking forward to the manifest and the purge logs once the hold ends.

Best,
Eleanor
